description: Lists the open times for a buyer consultation or a listing appointment with the chosen brokerage. Showings are not offered.

brokerage_id.description: A brokerage id, as listed by the brokerage search.

days.description: How many open days to list (1 to 14, default 7).

from.description: First day to look at, MM/DD/YYYY. Leave out for the next open days.

kind.description: buyer_consult: the person wants to buy a home. listing_appt: the person wants to sell their home.

name: open_times
title: Open times
